outcome: meconium staining of amniotic fluid parameters
cohort: The study included 357 pregnant women, categorized into groups with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (n=95), gestational diabetes mellitus (n=110), both conditions (n=16), and healthy pregnant women as controls (n=136).
finding: Plasma zonulin levels were significantly higher in pregnant women with ICP, GDM, or both conditions compared to healthy pregnant women, with the highest levels observed in those with coexisting GDM and ICP and an association with the severity of ICP and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
